text:
maria: Heads-up — after the 06:15 BMC rollout in us-central1 we're seeing ~30% of nodes in rack-r7 fail PXE. GPUs showing as unavailable in the scheduler.

kai: Can you paste the OOB status for one of the failing nodes? node ids?

maria: quick snippet from oob for node-7a3: ```
$ oobctl get-status node-7a3
node: node-7a3
secureboot: ENFORCED
bootmode: UEFI
last-pxe: 2025-10-12T06:12:03Z
attest: FAIL (keystore mismatch)
```

devon: that attestation fail + secureboot enforced is a known pattern when keystore rotation overlaps with BMC/bios image write. We saw something vaguely similar in a small canary last month.

ops-bot: Deploy-bot: Completed firmware rollout fw-roll-2025-10-12-usc1 -> racks: 12/12, status: success. No blockers reported in rollout job.

maria: But the BMC shows a cert-rotation event on 7 nodes that left them in ENFORCED with no matching attestation key. They won't accept our PXE chain.

sam: Impact: cluster autoscaler started evicting GPU pods; approx -220 GPUs capacity across the pool. We're spilling workloads to other regions; cost + perf hit.

kai: Two options: 1) full rollback of the firmware on impacted racks (slow, manual), or 2) temporarily relax secureboot at the host/vault layer so PXE can complete, then fix keystore order and reapply. Thoughts? :thinking_face:

devon: For fast recovery I support option 2 as a short-lived mitigation. Command on jumphost (needs oncall approval):
```bash
for n in $(cat impacted-nodes.txt); do oobctl set-secboot $n off --reason "temp-allow-pxe"; done
```
will clear ENFORCED and let the boot chain proceed.

maria: I'm running a canary rollback on rack-r7 now (2 nodes) to validate. If those come back healthy we can pick strategy. Monitoring logs.

ops-bot: Incident created INC-2025-4873. Paging: @kai (oncall). Escalation policy: infra-oncall -> eng-sre.

sam: Finance heads-up — if this drags >4h we'll burn through reserved fallback and trigger burst reprovisioning; estimate incremental cost ~+$12k/hr. Flagging for priority decision.

kai: @maria keep us posted on canary. If rollback fails we do the temporary secureboot relax and then coordinate a proper sequenced roll-forward (keystore -> bios -> bmc) with a preflight attestation check.

maria: Canary nodes just finished rebooting — node-7a3 came back green, PXE succeeded, scheduler reports GPU back. Continuing full rack rollback for r7.

devon: If rollback stabilizes r7, we'll prepare an updated runbook to reorder keystore rotation before the next batch.

ops-bot: Timeline note logged on INC-2025-4873: 06:15 rollout -> 06:28 first failures -> 06:33 rollback start -> 06:44 canary success.

sam: Good catch — please add postmortem and cost numbers once we stabilize.

kai: Nice work team. After rollback completes we should gate future rollouts on keystore-attest checks. :+1:
